data.name: UrbanRail Metro Simulator
data.detailed_description:
The Ultimate Metro Driving Experience

Dive into the depths of the city and take command of iconic train formations in UrbanRail Metro Simulator. From historic early 20th-century tunnels to the most modern networks, every journey will test your precision and technical knowledge.

Main Features:

  • Faithful Rolling Stock: Drive various types of trains, from the newest models to the oldest classics, including convoys like the CRRC-Citic 200 Series, the classic Nagoya Metro 5000 Series, and the legendary Fiat Materfer.

  • Real Safety Systems: Operate with authentic safety protocols. Master the ATP (Automatic Train Protection) system and advanced CBTC/ATO for precise semi-automatic driving.

  • Advanced Driving Physics: Feel the weight of the train. The simulator features an air-pressure-based braking system and realistic acceleration curves that vary based on passenger load.

  • Station Management: Control side-door operations, respect itinerary schedules, and ensure passenger safety at every station.

Detailed Systems:

  • Licensing System: Complete the required training courses for each convoy to fully unlock them.

  • ATP/CBTC & Deadman's Switch: Drive realistically by respecting signals and preventing the train from emergency braking through its protection systems.

  • Dynamic Passengers: Passengers have a destination to reach! Avoid delays to prevent stations from overcrowding and keep your schedule on track.

  • Real Lines: Travel through historic tunnels and photorealistic stations designed for a truly immersive experience.

Game Modes:

  • Driver: Operate your convoy safely through the tunnels and meet the schedule to avoid passenger overcrowding!

  • Train Guard: Control the opening and closing of the doors and manage train capacity to prevent passengers from blocking the doors!

  • Missions: Complete various challenges, from high-difficulty scenarios like driving with signal failures to simple tasks like operating the first service of the day.

Do you have what it takes to keep the network moving? Step into the cab and start your career in UrbanRail!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Dual-Core or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or higher) / AMD Radeon Vega 8
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad Core 3.0 GHz or higher (i5 / Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
